text: Filled it with ice at 7am before a 10 hour shift. There was still ice rattling around when I got home.
Finally a bottle that fits the cup holder in my car. My old one rolled around the floor every morning.
Goes from my desk to the gym to the trail on weekends. Same bottle all week. Lid is a bit stiff at first.
Leaked a little in my backpack when it was on its side. Not a lot but my notebook got wet.
Coffee was still hot at lunch. I did not expect that from a water bottle.
Paint chipped after I dropped it on concrete. Still works fine, just looks beat up.
Ice water on a 95 degree hike and it stayed cold the whole day. Worth it.
Heavier than my plastic bottle but I don't have to buy bottled water anymore.
I've lost 10 pounds since I started carrying this everywhere and drinking more water.
The carry loop is great. I clip it to my pack and forget about it.
Hard to open with gloves on. Fine in summer, annoying in winter.
Lid goes in the dishwasher, which is the only reason I still use a bottle every day.
Sand colour looks even better in person. Gets compliments at the office.

Dented it the first week. Customer service sent a replacement under warranty though.
One bottle for the commute, the gym, and the weekend. I stopped forgetting water at home.
